text: For a hundred years, every car was built the same way. Tesla just threw that out.
The Cybercab is built in three pieces. At the same time.
The front: a cast aluminum frame. Motor, drivetrain, electronics, fluids.
Suspension and brakes too. Brake by wire. No brake lines to the back.
Even the body panels are new. Polyurethane, with the color right in it.
So no paint shop. Hundreds of millions saved.
The back: another aluminum casting. Suspension, tailgate, panels.
The middle: the battery pack is the floor.
Seats and trim go straight on top.
Cast side frames close it in. Then the roof.
Then, the marriage. Front and back join the middle.
And the Hulk, a giant robot, sets the car on its wheels. For the very first time.
Tesla didn't build a better factory. It UNBOXED, THE, CAR.
